people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
translations.bsb: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
translations.asv: Jesus answered and said, This voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.
